definitions.gloss: good health; well-being (of the person addressed)
definitions.explanation: A formal word for someone else's good health, used almost only as ご{健勝|けんしょう} in letters, speeches and greetings: wishing the reader continued health, or saying one is glad they are well.

examples.japanese: ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈念|きねん}→祈念：30737_kinen⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I pray for the good health of you all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時下|じか}→時下：31853_jika⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I trust this finds you in ever better health.

notes:
A fixed word of formal letters (the opening greeting after ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧ and the closing wish) and of speeches at ceremonies. It is nearly always said of the other person, with ご; without ご it can occasionally describe one's own health in a formal reply.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: I am glad to know you are well (letter opening)
- ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ご⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{祈|いの}り→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: wishing you health and success (closing)
- ⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{健勝|けんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}って→祈る：01198_inoru⟧⟦{乾杯|かんぱい}→乾杯：00176_kanpai⟧: a toast to everyone's health

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧: health — the everyday word, used of anyone
- ご⟦{清栄|せいえい}→清栄：31865_seiei⟧: prosperity — the companion word in the same letter formula, often for companies
